operations.title: Operations
operations.subtitle: Income and expenses by account, transfers between own accounts
operations.totalsHint: Totals for the filter, excluding transfers
operations.emptyText: Add income or an expense, or load payments from the CRM.
operations.manualClientHint: Payments confirmed in the CRM arrive here automatically. Enter manually only payments that are not in the CRM.
operations.periodHint: The month the salary or tax is paid for
operations.transferHint: For example, a cash withdrawal from the bank account: the expense on one account and the income on the other are created together.

operations.amountToHint: Only if the account currencies differ

import.title: Load payments from CRM
import.text: Confirmed client payments and refunds for the period go to the accounts that have the payment method ticked. Payments already loaded are not repeated.

accounts.title: Accounts and wallets
accounts.subtitle: Bank accounts, cash and cards. Balance = opening balance + income − expenses
accounts.name: Name
accounts.openingDateHint: Operations before this date cannot be entered
accounts.crmMethodsHint: Payments confirmed in the CRM with these methods land in this account automatically
accounts.deleteConfirm: Delete the account? Only possible while it has no operations.
accounts.balanceHint: An account with operations cannot be deleted — deactivate it instead. A deactivated account accepts no new operations or CRM payments.
accounts.emptyText: Add a bank account, cash desk or card — then you can enter operations.

people.title: People for the tax office
people.subtitle: Who is officially employed: salary, PINFL, hire and termination dates
people.deleteConfirm: Delete this person? If there are accruals or payments, make them inactive instead.
people.emptyText: Add the people declared to the tax office to calculate payroll and taxes.

payroll.title: Tax payroll
payroll.subtitle: Monthly accrual, NDFL and INPS, paid and remaining
payroll.approveConfirm: Approve all drafts of the month? Approved rows can no longer be changed.
payroll.inpsWithin: INPS is withheld within NDFL: net = gross − NDFL.
payroll.inpsOnTop: INPS is withheld on top of NDFL: net = gross − NDFL − INPS.
payroll.grossHint: Salary on file: {salary}. Taxes will be recalculated.
payroll.paidWithoutAccrual: Payments without an accrual for this month
payroll.hint: “Calculate month” creates drafts for active people employed in the month (prorated by calendar days when hired or terminated mid-month). Approved rows are not recalculated. Paid = “Salary” expenses with this person and period.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.subtitle: Calculated automatically from the month’s payroll and receipts

taxes.noPayroll: Payroll for the month is not calculated yet:

how.TAX_NDFL: NDFL from the payroll (minus INPS when INPS is within NDFL)
how.TAX_ITPARK: From client payments and other income on bank accounts

taxes.hint: Rates: NDFL {ndfl}%, INPS {inps}%, IT Park {itpark}% — change them in accounting settings. Paid = expenses of the matching category with this period.

settings.title: Accounting settings
settings.subtitle: Tax rates for payroll and tax calculation

settings.itparkHint: Of the month’s receipts on bank accounts
